meta.source: The Ringer 2026 preseason rankings (Kelly / Heifetz / Horlbeck), half-PPR draft tracker, updated Aug 3 2026

strategy_doc.rb_priority: RB-weighted VONA. Pushes RB early and often without ignoring value.
strategy_doc.bpa: Pure value over replacement + VONA. No positional thumb on the scale.
strategy_doc.hero_rb: One elite RB in round 1, then WR/TE until round 5+.
strategy_doc.zero_rb: No RB before round 4; load WR/TE early, attack RB volume late.
